description:
Desktop AI agent with plugins, an embedded browser, workspace files, and local model support.

Lexora is a personal AI agent that evolves through hands-on work on your desktop. Beyond coding, it helps you organize research, refine creative projects, and plan everyday activities. Tell it what you want to accomplish, and it keeps working toward that goal, making words the starting point for work, creativity, and everyday life.
This update improves handoffs and continuation in multi-agent workflows. Companions can build on previous context and results to refine or rework an assignment, share relevant materials, and communicate directly with one another, reducing repeated explanations. Execution details now distinguish task requirements, delivery evidence, and review outcomes.
It also fixes issues with companion identity, coordination waits, and task completion feedback, while improving @mention routing and independent scheduling, access to previous reports, result actions, and usage display.
